prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: complete isolated building sprite variant, NOT a scene. EDIT TARGET image 1 is the exact accepted 651 x 403 native-pixel L-shaped warehouse. Image 2 is the existing player reference for readable small-game painted rendering only; do not draw any people. Keep the exact L footprint, every corner position, long front wall, left downwards extension, wall height, front roller shutter opening, roof hole, vents and pipes in their exact same locations and projection. The downwards extension is a CLOSED WALLED part, never fill it with rubble or open it. Whole outer silhouette must remain complete, with all objects wholly inside and generous TRANSPARENT margin; no furniture or props outside. Modify SURFACE TREATMENT ONLY to look grimdark, used and manually painted rather than polished AI/vector illustration. Muted weathered slate-blue roof panels instead of saturated pristine blue; broad irregular sun-faded and oily areas, localized soot around the existing impact hole, a few readable dented panels. Concrete corners have uneven chipped paint and some exposed dark aggregate; front bricks are patchy faded dirty red-brown with localized grey mortar loss, no uniform tiny perfect brick highlights. Pipes are dull rust and tarnished olive/copper, uneven but complete. Roller shutter is dull grey-green with a few larger dents and scratched missing paint. Dark varied angular brush-edged contours, restrained hard shadow shapes, 3-4 broad values per material. Keep short front-facing wall thickness and parallel square overhead axes EXACTLY. No changed camera, vanishing points, isometric diamonds or increased wall height. No photoreal micrograin, smooth gradients, glossy bevels, perfect repeated crisp highlights, neon illumination, new windows, new broken walls, dangling disconnected fragments, random debris, bodies, lettering or background. This is a controlled worn material style candidate; geometry is invariant.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one seamless square 2 x 2 pavement material tile, export target 128 x 128 pixels. Reference 1 is the existing orthogonal overhead warehouse and supplies the game's restrained painted linework/projection; reference 2 is tiny player scale/style only, do not draw a character or building. Primary request: a grimdark cyberpunk street sidewalk surface that looks naturally aged and hand-painted, avoiding the current overly clean AI/vector feeling. Four large approximately square concrete pavers, arranged two across and two down, each paver one native64 game cell. Pure straight overhead, full-bleed OPAQUE square material, NO perspective or isometric view, no surrounding margin. Broad warm grey and ashy grey-olive concrete masses, uneven worn dark grout, a few irregular broken corners, two or three asymmetrically placed branched cracks, localized embedded dirt, oil and soot staining in quiet broad color patches. Painterly angular hard-edged value groups and slightly irregular edge wear; surface readable at native128 with large calm areas, no microdetail/grain, no smooth plastic shading, no uniformly repeated damage on all four slabs, no bright fresh grass in every joint. No blood, corpses, props, shadow from an object, lamps, text, symbols or vignette. Diffuse neutral ambient surface, no painted directional lighting. The outer edges must tile seamlessly with themselves; keep the main 64px joint rhythm without thin decorative grid overlays. One material asset only.

framing_repair: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the just-created weathered L-shaped warehouse. Image 2 is the original exact complete geometry reference. Repair FRAMING ONLY: the full right-hand outer corner and right wall must be complete and visible, not chopped at the canvas edge. Fit the entire building comfortably inside the canvas with at least 6 percent genuinely TRANSPARENT EMPTY margin on all four sides. Preserve the target's aged matte slate-blue roof, tarnished pipes, irregular chipped concrete, faded patchy brick and hand-painted rough shading, same big roof hole and same shutter. Preserve the exact complete L footprint and short orthogonal overhead wall heights from image 2. Do not add any props, scenery, soil, rubble, people, new appendages, labels or a background. No camera/perspective change. Whole closed downwards left extension, whole long south front wall, all outer corners and vents intact. Ensure no opaque silhouette touches ANY image edge; transparent margin, complete geometry, no clipped or cut objects. Output one complete isolated sprite.
